tasks.label: Check admin login state
args: from core import config, security; from core.repos import users; user=users.get_by_username('admin'); print('database:', config.db_path()); print('admin_exists:', user is not None); print('known_password_matches:', bool(user and security.verify_password('NourEdu-2026#Access', user['password_hash'], user['password_salt']))); print('account_state:', None if user is None else {'active': bool(user['is_active']), 'locked': bool(user.get('locked_until')), 'failed_attempts': user.get('failed_attempts')})
